thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Canary error rate spike detected for prompt-router-experimental (route /v1/prompt). Creating incident INC-2026-1788. Paging oncall.
alan: seeing ~40% 5xx from canary nodes, p95 latency up 300ms.
maria: also noticed quality regression on a subset of prompts — increased hallucinations in tests.
oncall-jorge: I'm paged, joining. Which flag and which deploy?
sre-leah: flag=feature.prompt_router.experimental, canary pool prompt-router-canary-2026. Recommend immediate flag flip to route to stable and drain canary.
alan: agreed, prepping flag toggle.
alan: ```
# flip experimental routing off immediately
redwood feature toggle --env prod --flag feature.prompt_router.experimental --state off --reason "canary 5xx + quality regression" --author alan
```
incident-bot: Feature flag change submitted (author=alan). Audit id: AF-2026-778.
support-jess: heads-up — support queue shows 6 active threads referencing slow/incorrect responses, two named accounts flagged by CSMs (CUST-329, CUST-411). I'll send holding note after we confirm mitigation.
maria: starting rollback of canary deployment to previous image to be safe.
maria: ```
# rollback canary
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/prompt-router-canary --to-revision=42
```
oncall-jorge: PagerDuty updated: incident state=investigating. I'm taking lead, handoff to jenni in 30m for oncall rotation. Alan, please be owner for postmortem.
alan: acknowledged, will own postmortem and collect evals against prompt set.
sre-leah: telemetry: dropping 5xx to baseline within 90s of flag flip. Latency trending down. Continuing to monitor prefix cache effects.
support-jess: sent holding message to impacted customers: "We're investigating elevated errors on prompt routing, mitigation in progress; we'll follow up with details."
oncall-jorge: good. Also tagging legal/compliance for any PII risk — none spotted so far.
incident-bot: Monitor windows updated: metrics to watch: 5xx_rate, p95_latency, hallucination_regressions (eval score). Alert thresholds reenabled for stable route.
maria: running quick smoke eval set now, will paste results in 10m.
alan: collecting logs and kernel traces, will attach to the incident ticket.
sre-leah: recommend keeping FF off for 1 hour post-stable to ensure no cascading cache issues.
oncall-jorge: agreed. If any customer SLA hits, escalate to ELT.
support-jess: updating customers, will coordinate CSAT follow-up after postmortem.
alan: thanks all. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-1788 mitigation: feature flag flip + canary rollback applied. Please continue to add notes and mark incident resolved when metrics stable."
